title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Reforming Categorical Eligibility
issuer: Agriculture Department; Food and Nutrition Administration
summary: Under section 5(a) of the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008, households in which each member receives benefits under a State program funded by Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) are categorically eligible for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).
